name: AI Trend Video
tagline: Turn one photo into a viral trend video: pick a template, add a photo, get the video.
description: AI Trend Video makes short vertical videos in the style of current social media trends. You pick one of its trend templates (for example Hotel Lobby, NEON Dance, the flying car or Outstanding Tiny Desk), upload a photo of a person, pet or car, and the video is rendered in minutes. No prompt writing is needed. Paid, credit packs from $9.99, no free trial.
